text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Tch. And here I was thinking it was
surprisingly
peaceful today. Who had to
go and call me over
and ruin everything?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Nobody's here. Is there still noise in my
head or
something?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
The statue of the Three Goddesses is
here...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
How awesome would it be if I could get
some
data on them?
